name: Use the low-level AI Client Ability resolver and default timeout filter
query: On WordPress 7.0 I need to translate an Ability ID to the AI-safe function name, execute incoming function calls through an allow-list containing only my-plugin/lookup, and make subsequently created AI prompt builders use a 45-second default timeout. Which Core APIs should I use?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-ai-client with wp-abilities-api as the registration and permission reference
Step 2: Prefer using_abilities() for ordinary prompt-driven function calling, while recognizing this request needs the lower-level resolver
Step 3: Use WP_AI_Client_Ability_Function_Resolver::ability_name_to_function_name() and function_name_to_ability_name() for conversion
Step 4: Construct new WP_AI_Client_Ability_Function_Resolver('my-plugin/lookup') so only that Ability is allowed
Step 5: Call execute_ability($function_call)->getResponse() and preserve the Ability permission path
Step 6: Install wp_ai_client_default_request_timeout with add_filter before constructing the prompt builders that should inherit 45 seconds
Step 7: Do not confuse the Core timeout filter with the AI plugin's wpai_default_request_timeout filter
success_criteria: Uses both verified static conversion helper names
Uses the verified resolver constructor and execute_ability method
Explains that the timeout filter is read during builder construction
Keeps target Ability permission checks in the execution path
Does not invent resolver or timeout APIs
